## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works end to end on staging for the `fernhill` tenant with Fernhill's IdP: the RelayState rejection was fixed by storing the return URL in Redis behind a short opaque ID, and JIT provisioning (now merged in #415) creates users as `viewer`; group→role mapping is written and sits in the still-open PR #421. The remaining blocker before the demo is Fernhill IT adding the `groups` claim. (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open, not merged (commit `f4a91c7`) (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421, f4a91c7)
- [en-cours] Fernhill IT adding the `groups` claim on their side; the admin demo account waits on it (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] get #421 reviewed and merged (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] add one admin test account once the claim exists; demo Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] sending the full return URL as RelayState: their ADFS refused the login (`MSIS7042`, 143 bytes vs the 80-byte cap); replaced by server-side URL + short opaque ID (source: ses-sso-3)
- [essai-raté] first JIT test run failed on email case (`Daniel@Fernhill-Bank.example` vs the lowercase domain list); normalized to lowercase (source: ses-sso-2)
- [question] Dec 1 SSO enforcement / password login off for `fernhill` rests only on an agent note; and Fernhill's Slack ask (IdP-initiated only, `analyst` default) was refused but not yet answered to them (source: src-note-enforce, src-slack-fernhill)
- [décision] short opaque RelayState ID, return URL in Redis with a 10-minute TTL (source: s3-03)
- [décision] per-tenant group mapping: `Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` → `admin`, everything else `viewer` (source: s3-05)
- [décision] `viewer` stays the default until Maya talks to Fernhill; no `analyst` role; SP-initiated login stays on (source: s3-07)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC; both SP- and IdP-initiated flows (source: s1-03)
- [décision] JIT never creates a user from an unverified domain (source: s2-03)
- [décision] demo stays Thursday, 10:00 New York (source: s3-10)
